Hæc & illud accedit, quod eam, quæ vere Clementis est, ad Corinthios epi-stola, appareat, eam verum esse a Constitu-tionum auctore Clementem. Cum enim simbo-phanicis suis militantibus traditum, pla-que alteri eam tribuunt, quod & iam supra observavimus. Aequum est credere unam & eandem virum, qui qui-dem gravis fit ac lucius, rem eandem di-versis, ac continuo modo narrare. Non ergo idem & e Constitutionum auctor. Epistolæ vc-

page.notes: The text is very faded and show-through from the reverse side is present; the lower portion of the text block and the marginal notes at the right are largely illegible. The woodcut ornament sits mid-page and is not transcribed. Page number 230 and running head read "DE PSEUDEPIG." as printed. The catchword "JOAN-" is set in large capitals at the right foot.
